summary:
plan.md fixes the west Tunnel Tops on the mapped terrain (2x2 blocks per map cell). On the low flat sit the Outpost (a log Fort with a deck 8 up, log piles, a runnel) and a meadow; the Cliff Walk with two timber overlooks runs along the bluff top (z 44..58, where the map actually rises 3→7, not the brief's z 4..20; the brief's meadow at x 1..50 is paved W on the map, so the meadow is moved into the park).
Further south come the mounded Big Lawn and a smooth_stone two-bore portal at x 41 swallowing the Parkway (z 80..91). Calcite-and-spruce seating tiers and a promenade face north along the high south edge.
It reads as this park, not a generic lawn, through curving pale smooth_sandstone paths, grey-green, ochre and purple native drifts, wind-shorn flat-topped cypress groves, slim dark lamp posts, and four path crossings fixed at x 119 for the east half. West half of Tunnel Tops on the mapped terrain: pale curving smooth_sandstone paths, mounded Big Lawn, Outpost log Fort and play ground, Cliff Walk with two timber overlooks, calcite-and-spruce seating terraces and promenade, and a smooth_stone two-bore portal for the Parkway.
Native drifts (azalea mounds, grasses, allium/cornflower, dead bush) and wind-shorn dark cypress/pine groves fill the rest, lit by dark lamp posts and hidden light under moss carpet.
Six parts: terrain, portal, outpost, terraces, planting, lighting. No interior rooms.

parts.name: Terrain and paving
parts.scope: Whole-box ground (groundColumn from mapHeight; write heights.json), edge lock, roads/markings (roadStrip), walks/parking (walkStrip, stallLines), marsh and pond water, curving smooth_sandstone paths with halfStep (curvePath), Big Lawn mound (moundLawn), B pads flat. Elements 1-6.

parts.name: Tunnel portal and cut
parts.scope: portalFace at x41..42 z76..95 y5..10, two bores (tunnelBore z82/z89, black_concrete back x50, sea_lantern y8), retaining walls x28..40 stepping down west (retainWall), lid cover grass at y10 from x43, wall lanterns on the pier. Elements 7-10.

parts.name: Outpost play area
parts.scope: fortTower x80..85 z28..33, fenceNet, logPile x100..107, balanceLog x70..79, sand pit and playGround patches, boulders, runnel z38 x90..119, lowFence with gates, picnicTable x3 in the meadow. Elements 11-19.

parts.name: Overlooks, terraces and promenade
parts.scope: cliffRail on z57, overlookDeck x74..81 and x100..107 z50..56 with bench, tiers and seatWall at x52..77 and x100..115 z89..103, freestanding seat walls at z85, promenade z104..107 with planter and 6 benches. Elements 20-24.

parts.name: Planting and trees
parts.scope: shrubMound scrub on the north and west bluffs, drift of grey-green/ochre/purple in all P beds, meadow flowers (leave mown loop and paths clear), cypress and pine groves per the plan table, lid planting. Elements 25, 26, 18.

parts.name: Lamps and hidden light
parts.scope: lampPost every 9-10 along every path and at forks, 2 per deck, hiddenLight on an 11-block grid ringed by moss_carpet in lawn/meadow/planting, none in bores or on B pads; verify with $MCD light and check. Element 27.

recruit.why: Decode the height map, fill every column, soften steps with slabs, curve the pale paths and mound the lawn.
Portal face, bores and stepped retaining walls in courses with plinth and coping.
Log Fort, decks, rope net, log piles and balance logs from posts with set axes.
Overlook decks, seating walls, benches, picnic tables, railings.
Coastal scrub mounds, native drifts, wind-shorn cypress and pine groves.
Lamp posts every 9-10 blocks and hidden light so no mob spawns.
